tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the live Sacrosanct Space marketplace. Returns published service cards (creator, slug, title, summary, model, price in USDC per call). Only publicly listed Spaces appear.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Get a service's functions, inputs, price, purchase model, and the commerce_scope needed to buy. Refuses account-bound models with ACCOUNT_REQUIRED.

tools.name: prepare_purchase
tools.description: Prepare a guest per-call purchase: returns the authoritative price split, payment_id, purchase_ticket, reissued commerce_scope, and payment_plan. Pay by sending payment_plan.calls (to/value/data verbatim) from the buyer wallet as ONE atomic batch transaction on Base Mainnet — the platform call's dat

tools.name: complete_purchase
tools.description: After paying with prepare_purchase.payment_plan, submit the mined transaction hash with the payment_id, purchase_ticket, and commerce_scope. Verifies the payment on-chain, then executes the purchased function and returns its result.

tools.name: get_purchase_status
tools.description: Recover a purchase after a dropped connection: reports whether a (payment_id, tx_hash) pair was already consumed.
